name: Damon
description: An apprentice who fails a mirror test but kills a Stromgald assassin and realizes he is already a wizard.

description_citations.text: "The Colors of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Damon kills a Stromgald assassin by using the mirror to make her believe she is a healer, and learns he is already a wizard.
timeline.quote: The ordeal makes Damon realize what his master meant when he said he would never become a wizard - because he was already a wizard.

citation.text: "The Colors of Magic", section "The Mirror of Yesterday , by Jonathan Tweet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Damon failed Wane's Mirror of Yesterday test and was told he would never become a wizard.
timeline.quote: Wane told Damon then that he would never become a wizard.

timeline.summary: The assassin killed Annarais; Damon tricked the golem into smashing the assassin.
timeline.quote: Damon then tricked the golem into attacking her
